main.description: Activities from athletes the viewer follows, plus the viewer's own, by feed position, newest first: the earliest of when each was posted, when it was indexed and 5 days after it ended. Unfiltered, a batch import's activities posted more than 5 days after they ended come as one import card when the viewer may see at least 5 of them. Requires auth.

type.description: Only activities of these types (any one matches): a feed.activity sport value, which matches every sub-sport, or 'sport:subSport', which matches exactly. An empty value or one with an empty part or more than one ':' is rejected with InvalidRequest; a well-formed value no activity has matches nothing.

since.description: Only activities that started at or after this. Inclusive.

until.description: Only activities that started before this. Exclusive; must be after since when both are given (InvalidRequest otherwise).

feed.description: An open union: later AppViews may add other kinds of item, which older clients skip.
